title: IDK
description: A lightweight local development deployment tool designed to orchestrate containers. Automatically provisions mock networking environments, injects secrets, and configures proxy redirects.

title: Arduino TUI
description: A user friendly Terminal User Interface built on top of Arduino CLI. Programmed using Python's Textual framework to display compile progress and read serial telemetry logs.

title: NE1
description: A clean, keyboard-driven Wayland desktop environment configuration built on top of the Sway window manager. Integrates custom status bars, workflow automations, and unified theme configurations for instant deployment on Linux.
